chatMaxChars.description:
Per-platform chat message max length (already exposed via
`ChatPlatform::max_message_chars`, mirrored here for convenience).

chatOverlayPollMs.description: Polling interval for chat overlay state (ms).

chatPollIntervalMs.description: Polling interval for refreshing chat platform status (ms).

obsTriggerDelayMs.description: Delay before triggering SpiritStream when OBS starts streaming (ms).

retryBaseDelayMs.description: Base delay for HTTP retry with exponential back-off (ms).

themeInitTimeoutMs.description:
Hard timeout for theme initialization on app start (ms). After this,
the UI falls back to the default theme rather than blocking forever.

themeTokenRetryDelayMs.description: Delay between theme-token fetch retry attempts (ms).
